adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is true, it does `const response = await fetch(...)` and returns the raw Fetch `Response` object without checking `response.ok` or parsing JSON. Multiple callers in this diff clearly expect non-Fetch shapes: e.g. Google Calendar does `const token = res?.data;` after calling `refreshOAuthTokens(...)`, but a Fetch `Response` has no `.data`, so `token` becomes undefined and `token.access_token` will throw. Hubspot assigns the return value to `HubspotToken`, but would receive a Fetch `Response` in the sync branch. There is also no AbortSignal/timeout, so a hanging sync endpoint would block these code paths indefinitely.
